title: Red Tape Grey Straight Fit Stretch Jeans
shortDescription: Build a dependable everyday rotation with the Red Tape jeans for men in grey, created to combine authentic denim character, comfortable movement, dependable structure, and versatile casual styling.
description: Build a dependable everyday rotation with the Red Tape jeans for men in grey, created to combine authentic denim character, comfortable movement, dependable structure, and versatile casual styling. Crafted from 77% cotton, 21% polyester, and 2% spandex knitted fabric, these jeans combine cotton comfort and polyester-supported structure with stretch-enhanced flexibility for easier movement. The straight fit creates a clean, balanced silhouette with comfortable room for natural movement, making the pair easy to wear through commutes, relaxed workdays, weekend plans, travel, and daily outings. The solid grey denim finish gives the pair a modern, easy-to-coordinate appearance, while the functional pocket design provides useful everyday storage. Pair them with T-shirts, polos, casual shirts, sweatshirts, or jackets for effortless everyday dressing.
